name: Anonymous Sudan
description: Anonymous Sudan (AnonSudan) was a DDoS-for-hire cybercriminal operation run by Sudanese brothers Ahmed Salah Yousif Omer (22) and Alaa Salah Yusuuf Omer (27), arrested in March 2024. Despite presenting as ideological hacktivists, the FBI revealed their high-profile attacks were commercials for a DDoS service selling 100 attacks/day for $150. The group took down Microsoft cloud services, PayPal, Twitter/X, OpenAI, the FBI and State Department websites, and targeted hospitals globally.
